name: Alaris: Season's Greetings
source:
Set in the world of the Visual Novel Alaris, the new season, winter, is upon us. Each season's arrival is an important time of year for the townspeople, given their respect and connection to nature.

As a healer, you typically find yourself inundated by waves of new patients - winter often bringing harsher conditions that leave people vulnerable to sickness. However, this winter, you find yourself with some free time, now that you're working with Central.

With time on your hands, you consider how - or rather, who - to spend your first Season's Greetings off in a while. How will you decide to greet the season, and what surprises might be in store for you? Find out in this sweet, casual winter side story: Season's Greetings!

[Taken from [url=https://crescence-studio.itch.io/alaris-seasons-greetings]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
以视觉小说《阿拉里斯》的世界为背景，新的季节——冬天即将来临。鉴于镇民对自然的尊重和联系，每个季节的到来对于镇民来说都是一年中的重要时刻。

作为一名治疗师，你通常会发现自己被一波又一波的新病人淹没——冬天往往会带来更恶劣的条件，使人们容易生病。然而，今年冬天，你发现自己有了一些空闲时间，因为你在Central工作。

有了空闲时间，你就可以考虑如何（或者更确切地说，与谁）度过一段时间后的第一个季节问候。你将决定如何迎接这个季节，又会给你带来怎样的惊喜呢？在这个甜蜜、休闲的冬季支线故事中找到答案：季节的问候！

[摘自[url=https://crescence-studio.itch.io/alaris-seasons-greetings]itch.io[/url]]
